aggressive_definition: Advanced prostate cancer, defined as stage 3 or higher or prostate cancer death.
aggressive_definition_excerpt: including 371 with advanced disease (stage 3 or higher or prostate cancer death).
study_design: Population-based prospective cohort with registry linkage; milk intake was assessed in a subgroup in 2002-2006.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: a population-based cohort of 8,894 men born between 1907 and 1935.
reason: The abstract reports incident total prostate cancer and a prespecified advanced incident endpoint during cohort follow-up. It also reports an association between adolescent milk consumption and advanced prostate cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Daily milk consumption in adolescence (vs. less than daily), but not in midlife or currently, was associated with a 3.2-fold risk of advanced prostate cancer (95% CI: 1.25, 8.28).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns adolescent milk intake and explicitly defined advanced prostate cancer. The abstract rounds the effect to 3.2, whereas the existing row records 3.22.
